changes.title: Lion
items: A new creature for the hot south: the lion, a big tawny cat with a dark mane and a tufted tail, and its own area, the Savanna: tall gold grass under flat-topped acacias and baobabs, a kopje of sun-warmed boulders
The lion's legend, asleep in the long grass, gives Lion's Pride: 💌s fly a little faster and further

changes.title: Raccoon
items: A new animal for the cold rainforest: the raccoon, in its bandit mask, prowling a mossy creek under towering spruces and cedars
Its legend's boon, Light fingers: quicker 💌 bursts

changes.title: Armadillo
items: A new animal for the badlands: the armadillo, trundling through its scrub wash among thorn trees and junipers, and charging you curled up
Its legend rolls about as a glowing ball, the seams between its bands alight
Its legend's boon, Roll: a little longer blink, and untouchable a little longer after it
